segment.source: How the control applies algorithms: Unspecified, Disabled, Global, or Custom.
segment.target: How o controle applies algorithms: Unspecified, Desativado, Global, ou Personalizado.

segment.source: Ordered ThemeAlgorithm values used only when Algorithm is Custom.
segment.target: Ordered ThemeAlgorithm values usado somente quando Algorithm é Personalizado.

segment.source: Global Token and Own Token overrides applied only to the selected Control identity.
segment.target: Global Token e Own Token overrides applied somente para o selecionado Controle identity.

segment.source: Ordered ThemeAlgorithm values. A null value inherits the parent algorithm chain.
segment.target: Ordered ThemeAlgorithm values. A null valor inherits o pai algorithm chain.

segment.source: Control theme configurations keyed by ControlTokenIdentity.
segment.target: Controle tema configurations keyed por ControlTokenIdentity.

segment.source: Whether this configuration inherits and merges the parent theme configuration.
segment.target: Whether este configuration inherits e merges o pai tema configuration.

segment.source: Immutable scoped theme configuration. Runtime updates replace the complete value.
segment.target: Immutable scoped tema configuration. Runtime updates replace o complete valor.

segment.source: Global token overrides keyed by token name.
segment.target: Global token overrides keyed por token name.

segment.source: Every publicly themeable Control has an independent identity. Its configuration can override any Global Token and that Control's Own Tokens; the overrides affect only the selected Control and do not leak to other Controls.
segment.target: Every publicly themeable Control has an independent identity. Its configuration can override any Global Token and that Control's Own Tokens; the overrides affect only the selected Control and do not leak to other Controls.

segment.source: By modifying token property of theme, we can modify Design Token globally. Some tokens will affect other tokens. We call these tokens Seed Token.
segment.target: Por modifying token propriedade de tema, nós pode modify Design Token globally. Some tokens irá affect outro tokens. Nós call these tokens Seed Token.

segment.source: By nesting ConfigProvider you can apply a local theme to part of your page. Design Tokens that are not changed in the child theme inherit from the parent theme.
segment.target: Por nesting ConfigProvider você pode apply a local tema para part de seu página. Design Tokens que são não alterado em o child tema inherit de o pai tema.

segment.source: Customize Theme demonstrates how ThemeConfigProvider overrides Global Tokens, applies preset algorithms, configures Control Tokens, and nests theme contexts without changing the global application theme.
segment.target: Personalizar Tema demonstrates how ThemeConfigProvider overrides Global Tokens, applies predefinido algorithms, configures Controle Tokens, e nests tema contexts sem changing o global application tema.

segment.source: Customize AtomUI themes with Global Tokens, algorithms, Control Tokens, and nested local theme scopes.
segment.target: Personalizar AtomUI temas com Global Tokens, algorithms, Controle Tokens, e nested local tema scopes.

segment.source: Themes with different styles can be quickly generated by modifying algorithm. Ant Design 5.0 provides three sets of preset algorithms by default: DefaultAlgorithm, DarkAlgorithm, CompactAlgorithm.
segment.target: Temas com diferente styles pode ser quickly generated por modifying algorithm. Ant Design 5.0 provides três define de predefinido algorithms por padrão: DefaultAlgorithm, DarkAlgorithm, CompactAlgorithm.

segment.source: Replace ThemeConfigProvider.Config with a new immutable ThemeConfig to publish one scoped snapshot without adding resource provider layers.
segment.target: Replace ThemeConfigProvider.Config with a new immutable ThemeConfig to publish one scoped snapshot without adding resource provider layers.
